notes.title: New patch: Stability & bug fixing
notes.notes:
Hi players,

A new [b]patch[/b] for [i]EDENGATE: The Edge of Life[/i] is now available for download, which includes bug fixing and additional improvements.

Here’s the [b]changelog[/b]:

[list]
[*]General stability improvements
[*]Framerate capped at 120 fps
[*]Crash fix leaving Gallery[/list]

Thank you for your patience and your feedback!

HOOK Team

notes.title: New Release date: 15th November 2022
notes.notes:
Hi players,

To give you the best experience possible in [i]EDENGATE: The Edge of life[/i], we have decided to slightly postpone the release of the game to[b] November 15th, 2022[/b]. These two additional weeks will allow our small dev team to polish all the necessary details.

Soon you will be able to explore and discover all the secrets that lie behind Mia's story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42926663/e664857cdd9bdf7558592ca0b4bfd5ec167ecac1.jpg[/img]

Thank you for your support and patience,

HOOK Team
